list.title: Messages
list.empty: Messages appear here once syncing lands.

reading.title: Reading
reading.empty: Select a message to read it.

connect.title: Connect to your mailbox
connect.label: Email address or server
connect.hint: Enter your email address and {{product}} finds your server automatically.

error.discovery: No mail server was found for {{domain}}.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.noAccount: This server has no mail account for you.
error.config: This deployment has no server configured to connect to.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

oauth.unavailable: Secure sign-in needs an HTTPS connection. Use your username and password below.

basic.appPasswordHint: With two-factor authentication, use an app-specific password.

error.oauthUnavailable: This server requires secure (HTTPS) sign-in, which is not available here.

reauth.title: Session expired
reauth.body: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue — your place is kept.

confirmRemove.title: Remove all local data?
confirmRemove.body: This deletes {{product}}'s locally stored mail and settings on this device. Mail on the server is not affected.

outbox.stuck_one: Still trying to reach the server ({{count}})
outbox.stuck_other: Still trying to reach the server ({{count}})

storage.full: Storage is full — some mail is not cached.

offline.title: Offline & storage
offline.description: {{product}} keeps recent mail on this device so it opens instantly and works offline.
offline.quotaUnknown: Your browser does not report a storage quota.

persist.label: Keep data on this device
persist.hint: Ask your browser not to delete cached mail when storage runs low.
persist.granted: Granted — your browser will keep cached mail even when storage runs low.
persist.denied: Not granted — your browser may clear cached mail when storage runs low.

offline.window_one: Mail from the last {{count}} day is kept offline.
offline.window_other: Mail from the last {{count}} days is kept offline.

remote.label: Load remote images automatically
remote.hint: Remote images tell the sender that you opened the message, and reveal your IP address. Off is the safe choice.

autoMarkRead.label: Mark messages as read when opened
autoMarkRead.hint: After a short pause, so scrolling past a message does not mark it.

left.label: Swipe left
left.hint: Drag a message to the left on a touchscreen. Archive does nothing if this account has no Archive folder.

right.label: Swipe right
right.hint: Drag a message to the right on a touchscreen.

undoSend.label: Undo send
undoSend.hint: How long a sent message waits before it actually leaves.

signature.label: Signature placement
signature.hint: Where your signature is added when you reply or forward.

vacation.title: Vacation responder
vacation.description: Automatically reply once to everyone who writes to you.
vacation.timezoneHint: Times are in your local timezone ({{zone}}). Leave a field empty for no limit.

status.expired: The end date has passed — no replies are being sent.

error.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
error.conflict: The vacation responder was changed elsewhere. Your changes were not saved — the current settings are shown above.
error.offline: You are offline. The vacation responder can only be changed while connected.
error.generic: The vacation responder could not be saved.

server.title: Server
server.description: What this JMAP server offers. Useful when reporting a problem.
server.coreMissing: This server advertises no standard capability object. That is unusual — some features may not work.
server.mailMissing: This account advertises no mail capability, so no mail limits can be shown.

detail.title: Contact
detail.empty: Select a contact to see their details.

form.photoError: The photo could not be uploaded.

delete.title: Delete contact
delete.body: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}?

delete.title: Delete folder?
delete.messageNonEmpty: “{{name}}” contains {{count}} messages. Delete it and its contents? This cannot be undone.

error.nameTaken: A folder with this name already exists here.

move.title: Move {{name}}
move.empty: There is no folder this one can move into.

list.viewOptionsUnavailable: Sorting and conversation view apply to folders only.
list.confirmDeleteBody_one: This message will be permanently deleted. This can’t be undone.
list.confirmDeleteBody_other: These {{count}} messages will be permanently deleted. This can’t be undone.
list.stale: This list is out of date and will refresh on the next sync.

reading.confirmDeleteBody: This message will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone.

remote.title: Remote content blocked
remote.privacyNote: Images and other remote content can track when you open a message.

reading.draftLead: This is a draft you haven't sent yet.

authResults.label: Authentication
authResults.unverified: This report comes from the message itself and cannot be verified. Do not rely on it alone to judge whether a message is genuine.

reading.nameLooksLikeAddress: The name shown is not the sender's real address

linkWarning.title: This link may not be genuine
linkWarning.lead: The text of this link names one website, but the link opens a different one. That is how phishing messages work.
linkWarning.note: Open it only if you are certain it is genuine. If in doubt, close this and type the address into your browser yourself.

source.title: Message source
source.truncated: Showing the beginning of this message only ({{size}} in total). Save it as .eml to see all of it.

error.offline: The message source could not be loaded because you are offline.
error.notFound: This message is no longer on the server.
error.failed: The message source could not be loaded.

error.notParsable: This attached message couldn't be opened.
error.failed: This attached message couldn't be opened.

nested.truncated: Showing the beginning of this message only. Download the attachment to see all of it.

compose.discardBody: This draft will be permanently deleted.
compose.attachQuota: Upload limit reached — please try again later
compose.sendNoIdentity: Choose a From address before sending
compose.sendNoSentMailbox: No Sent folder — cannot send yet
compose.sendUnavailable: Not ready to send yet — please try again in a moment
compose.sendTooLarge: Attachments are too large to send
compose.closeWaitUploads: Uploads still in progress — window minimized
compose.sendErrorQuota: Message not sent — mailbox is over quota
compose.sendErrorGeneric: Message could not be sent — it's saved in Drafts
compose.attachMentionBody: You mentioned an attachment but none is attached.
compose.sendErrorInterrupted: Interrupted before we could confirm — check Sent before resending

search.label: Search
search.hint: Try from:, to:, subject:, has:attachment, is:unread, in:, before:, after:

labels.title: Labels
labels.discoveredHint: Labels found on synced messages. Only messages in your offline window are shown.

delete.title: Delete label?
delete.message: Remove the label “{{name}}”? Messages keep the underlying keyword.
delete.alsoStrip: Also remove it from {{count}} known messages

error.taken: A label with this name already exists.

empty.title: Empty “{{name}}”?
empty.message_one: Permanently delete {{count}} message in “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
empty.message_other: Permanently delete {{count}} messages in “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
empty.retention: {{product}} deletes these on the server. Your provider may keep its own backups outside {{product}}’s control.

older.title: Delete older messages
older.messageTrash_one: Move messages in “{{name}}” older than {{count}} day to the Trash?
older.messageTrash_other: Move messages in “{{name}}” older than {{count}} days to the Trash?
older.messageDestroy_one: Permanently delete messages in “{{name}}” older than {{count}} day? This cannot be undone.
older.messageDestroy_other: Permanently delete messages in “{{name}}” older than {{count}} days? This cannot be undone.
older.noteTrash: Moved messages stay in the Trash until you empty it.
older.retention: {{product}} deletes these on the server. Your provider may keep its own backups outside {{product}}’s control.

failed.title: Couldn’t clean up “{{name}}”
failed.body: This didn’t go through. Check your connection and try again.

conflict.moveFolderGone: Couldn't move — that folder was deleted.
conflict.messageGone: That message no longer exists on the server.
conflict.contactGone: That contact no longer exists on the server.
conflict.forbidden: You don't have permission for that.
conflict.tooLarge: That's too large for the server.
conflict.stateConflict: Someone else changed that at the same time.

send.willSendWhenOnline: Will send when you're back online
send.queuedOffline: You're offline — this will send when you reconnect
send.label: Queued messages

update.title: An update is ready
update.body: Reload to use the new version. Open drafts are saved first.

install.title: Install {{product}}
install.body: Installing gives you an app icon, a faster start, and access to your mail without a browser window.

ios.title: Add to Home Screen

steps.share: Tap the Share button in Safari.
steps.open: Open {{product}} from the new icon on your Home Screen.

ios.pushNote: On iPhone and iPad, mail notifications only work when the app runs from the Home Screen.

chunk.title: Something went wrong
chunk.body: Part of the app could not be loaded. Reloading usually fixes it.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: {{product}} notifies you about new mail whenever it is running — including in a background tab or window.

permission.denied: Your browser is blocking notifications for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then reload {{product}}.
permission.dismissed: Notifications were not allowed. Turn the switch on again to be asked once more.
permission.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
permission.iosInstall: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work when {{product}} runs from the Home Screen. Add it there first.

folders.label: Notify for these folders
folders.hint: New mail in other folders is still synced — it just stays quiet.

quiet.label: Quiet hours
quiet.hint: No notifications between these times. A range that crosses midnight is allowed.

preview.label: Show sender and subject
preview.hint: When off, a notification only says that new mail arrived — useful on a shared screen.

sound.label: Play a sound
sound.hint: Whether a sound is actually played is up to your operating system.

background.unavailable: Notifications while {{product}} is fully closed are not available with this server. They need the server to publish a Web-Push signing key (RFC 9749); this one does not. Everything above works whenever {{product}} is open.
background.available: This server can also notify you while {{product}} is closed.
background.contentless: Those notifications say only that mail arrived — never the sender or the subject — and the folder setting above does not apply to them.
background.renewal: Open {{product}} at least once a week to keep them coming: this server renews the background subscription for seven days at a time, and only {{product}} itself can renew it.

quota.label: Mailbox storage
quota.warnToast: Your mailbox is nearly full. New mail may soon be rejected.
quota.fullToast: Your mailbox is full. New mail is being rejected until you free up space.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.targetNote: Shortcuts act on the selected messages — or, when nothing is selected, on the open message, otherwise on the focused row.
shortcuts.editorNote: While the cursor is in a message body the editor keeps its own shortcuts (bold, italic, insert link).

unavailable.archive: This account has no Archive folder.
unavailable.junk: This account has no Junk folder.
unavailable.trash: This account has no Trash folder.
unavailable.hint: Press V to pick a folder instead.
